paragraphs: Hi, Grandma! It is Saturday, and the sun is hot. Mom, Pat, and I are at the funfair in the town square. Please come to us after lunch. Call Mom when you get off the bus. Here is the way. Take bus number twelve from the bus stop near our house. Get off at the shopping center. It is a big white building with a red roof. You can see it from the bus.

Walk out of the shopping center and turn left. Go straight along the big road. The walk is short, and you do not need a map. Then you see a supermarket on your right. Walk by the supermarket and turn right at the café. The café is opposite a small bus station. A band plays music loudly in the square. This road is short and easy. The square is at the end of the road.

In the square, there is a tall tree. The funfair is behind the tree. Pat is sitting on a chair under the tree. He wants to go on the big wheel with you. Mom is next to the ice cream shop. She has a red balloon in her hand. Look for the red balloon. When you can't find us, ask someone. Say, "Where is the funfair, please?" Do you know the way now? We are very happy to see you. Love, May.
text.summary: May sends a message to Grandma with directions from the bus stop to the funfair in the town square. She also tells Grandma where Mom and Pat are.
